seo.title: e-Psychiatry: Enterprise Telepsychiatry Review | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: e-Psychiatry provides B2B telepsychiatry for hospitals, EDs, nursing homes, and correctional facilities. 7,000+ providers, hourly rate model since 2007.

faqs.q: Can I use e-Psychiatry as a patient?
faqs.a: Not directly. e-Psychiatry is a B2B service for healthcare facilities, not a consumer app. You'd access their psychiatrists through a hospital, clinic, nursing home, or other facility that contracts with them. They do have a consumer-facing component but primarily serve facilities.

faqs.q: What types of facilities does e-Psychiatry serve?
faqs.a: Hospital EDs, inpatient psychiatric units, community mental health centers (CMHCs), nursing homes/long-term care, schools, correctional facilities, and primary care practices. They provide telepsychiatry, teletherapy, and on-site staffing.

Straight hourly rate for provider time. No upfront fees, no consulting fees, no technology fees. Facilities pay only for the hours providers work. This makes it easier to try without large upfront investment.

faqs.q: Does e-Psychiatry integrate with our EMR?
faqs.a: Yes. Their providers use your facility's EMR directly, follow your policies and procedures, and function as part of your clinical team rather than a separate service. This avoids the fragmentation issues common with other telepsychiatry vendors.

faqs.q: How big is e-Psychiatry's provider network?
faqs.a: 7,000+ providers including psychiatrists, PMHNPs, PAs, psychologists, and therapists across all 50 states. One of the oldest telepsychiatry companies (since 2007) with extensive national coverage.

faqs.q: How does e-Psychiatry compare to Array Behavioral Care?
faqs.a: Both are B2B telepsychiatry providers. e-Psychiatry is older (2007 vs. Array's predecessor founding in 1999) and charges hourly without upfront fees. Array is larger by hospital partnerships (450+) and has more sophisticated measurement tools (Care Pathways). e-Psychiatry's simpler model may appeal to smaller facilities.
